specification: 4-variable flow baseline (GDP, inflation, reserves, reserve growth)
selection_rationale: Simple linear baseline; lower pooled discrimination and recall than extended specification.
Retained as primary interpretable research specification; superior pooled discrimination and GFC detection, but explicitly qualified by lack of non-2007 generalization.
Lower Brier score due to conservative probability calibration, but lower discrimination and higher complexity than logistic models.
Strong probability compression toward zero; misses 17 of 19 crises at default threshold (recall 10.5%); not suitable as primary early warning model.
